checks.detail: Both locked profiles installed and the candidate version activated from the bundled installer.
Generated loopback-only configuration, per-install tokens, separate user data, and no operation grants.
Packaged Core became ready; both Host processes were active, error-free, and launched from the installed version while system Node/Python were absent from PATH.
Authenticated shutdown returned HTTP 202 and removed Core/Host processes.
Application versions were removed while daemon configuration and SQLite user data remained.
